usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and Smartping texts the buyer through “Send SMS” after an “Order Paid”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Send SMS” in Smartping
bestTemplate.why: Payment confirmation goes to the buyer with your sender ID, sent through your Smartping account.

watchOut: “Send SMS” needs a sender ID and DLT details, so have them ready before “Order Paid” runs.
